description: Fired when a user successfully logs in (dev auth or Google OAuth)
Fired when an admin successfully creates a new lecture
Fired when an admin deletes a lecture
Fired when an admin publishes a lecture (status: proofread → published)
Fired when a user views a lecture detail page — top of content engagement funnel
Fired when a user submits a search query on the search page
Fired when a user clicks on a search result card to view a lecture
Fired when a contributor opens the transcript editor
Fired when a transcript is saved (autosave or manual Ctrl+S)
Fired when a corrector marks their transcript corrections as complete (assigned → corrected)
Fired when a proofreader marks proofreading as complete (corrected → proofread)
Fired when an admin assigns a corrector to a lecture
Fired when a user adds a comment on a lecture transcript
